label: Benzo(a)pyrene aggregating lung inflammation via inducing IL1R1 expression in asthma: Insights from network toxicology, single-cell transcriptomics, and Mendelian randomization.
summary: Exposure to benzo(a)pyrene (BaP) negatively affects lung inflammation in patients with asthma. However, there is a lack of systematic research on the key mechanisms of BaP toxicity in asthma. In this study, BaP target genes were predicted using ChEMBL, SEA, and PharmMapper, and asthma-related genes were retrieved from GeneCards, OMIM, and TTD.
